title: A Self is marked by goals, compound memories and credit assignment above its parts

fields.label: Label
fields.value: A Self is marked by goals, compound memories and credit assignment above its parts

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: TAME defines the hallmarks of a Self as the ability to pursue goals, to own compound (e.g. associative) memories, and to serve as the locus of credit assignment (reward or punishment), each at a scale larger than any of its components can achieve alone.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: An Experimentally-Grounded Framework for Understanding Diverse Bodies and Minds

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2022, Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: An Experimentally-Grounded Framework for Understanding Diverse Bodies and Minds › Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: A Proposal for a Framework › Specific Conceptual Components of the Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere Framework

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: The TAME framework takes the following as the basic hallmarks of being a Self: the ability to pursue goals, to own compound (e.g., associative) memories, and to serve as the locus for credit assignment (be rewarded or punished), where all of these are at a scale larger than possible for any of its components alone.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: An Experimentally-Grounded Framework for Understanding Diverse Bodies and Minds”, Frontiers in systems neuroscience (2022), doi:10.3389/fnsys.2022.768201; section “Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: A Proposal for a Framework › Specific Conceptual Components of the Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere Framework”. Scope: Any agent, biological or engineered

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2022-tame-07: not-empirically-resolvable, resolvability 0.16

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Goals, memory, and reinforcement effects can each be studied, but the claim defines rather than discovers the hallmarks of Selfhood. Data cannot decide among alternative definitions without an external criterion.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: The three proposed hallmarks can be measured for selected systems, but no observation can independently validate that this stipulated conjunction is what constitutes a Self.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Goal ownership and credit assignment depend on contested system boundaries.

The claim is principally a framework definition.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The text presents these three capacities as the basic hallmarks TAME will use. A system that shows them fits the definition, and a system that lacks them falls outside it. Public data can hunt for the capacities and cannot confirm or refute the stipulation that they are what a Self is.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Goals, associative memory, and credit assignment can be measured in a particular system, but finding them would illustrate this definition of a Self rather than test it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value: The statement stipulates the hallmarks of a Self, so empirical cases are examples of the definition.
